newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at light steady levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at light steady levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at steady thin levels on Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Tuesday.
One barge, Lacon, Illinois River, this week, bid 100 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Illinois River, this week, bid 100 percent of tariff, unchanged from Tuesday, similar, no offer.
- Two barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 110 percent, no comparison, offer 115 percent, no comparison.
